name: SBX-S
notes: S&B Katalog 2026 (EN): SBX-S (1. FP), aydınlatma Luminescence Technology; 'clear, illuminated central crosshair'; 'The new SBX-S is identical to the SBX reticle except for the wind hold points.'; mesafe taretle, rüzgâr yatay işaretlerle. SBX metni: 'free-floating red dot covering only 0.065 mrad'; 'The illuminated crosshair measures 2 mrad from the center to its outer structure' -> unit=mil. ÇIKARIM: center_dot=true, floating_center=true SBX ile 'identical ... except for the wind hold points' ifadesinden. SBX'in 'Christmas-tree' tutma noktaları SBX-S'te yok -> family null (ağaç değil; ızgara düzeni verilmemiş). Aralıklar/uzanım verilmemiş -> null.
